text:
maria: Heads up — seeing reproducible token corruption when tiled prefill crosses the 8k boundary on v1.3-q4 (quantized). Happens only with tiled prefill + prefix caching enabled. test id: nightly-2026-03-19-tiling-23 :thinking:

devon: Can you share the minimal repro steps / command you used?

maria: repro steps:
1) checkout model v1.3-q4
2) run `./tests/longctx_prefill --model v1.3-q4 --seq 10000 --tile 2048 --quant int4 --prefill cache`
3) compare logits from warm vs tiled prefill

kevin: I suspect a window-tiling alignment issue — maybe tile boundaries not aligning with internal KV pages. Try shifting the tile offset by small amounts (16/32) to see if it moves the corruption.

ana: (typo) ana: i've seen a similar corruption once but it was on int8 with memcpy padding problems, different error message though. run id: qa-2025-11-02-kv-pad

maria: here's the failing log snippet (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-19 22:07:12] kv_cache: prefill tiled start=6144 tile_size=2048
[2026-03-19 22:07:12] kv_cache: memcpy src_offset=6144 dst_offset=0 bytes=16384
[2026-03-19 22:07:12] kv_check: mismatch at token_index=6240 expected=0x7f got=0x3a
[2026-03-19 22:07:12] trace: tile_align=(8,2048) page_align=64
```

ci-bot: nightly-tiling-23 finished: 1 failure, logs uploaded https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/nightly-tiling-23 (artifacts/logs/tiling-23.tar.gz)

kevin: if disabling prefix cache removes it then cache merge path is suspect. Can you try `--prefill none` and `--prefill cache --tile 2064` (non-multiple) and see results? Also try `--align 64`.

maria: quick experiments: `--prefill none` => no corruption. `--prefill cache --tile 2064` => corruption still present but shifted (mismatch token_index=6256). `--align 64` => corruption gone but perf -12%. So alignment mitigates but doesn't fix root cause.

devon: sounds like an off-by-chunk-copy in tiled memcpy that only surfaces when quantized packing/stride != page size. Can we add an assert in memcpy tracing for overlap/unaligned end?

ana: +1 on packing hypothesis. In int4 we pack 2 tokens/byte; tile edge fractional byte could cause stale half-bytes if memcpy copies whole bytes without mask. Worth checking the pack/unpack boundary code in quantize.cc.

maria: next steps proposal:
- open ticket with repro steps + artifact link (i'll do this)
- add a unit test in kv_cache_test that exercises non-page-aligned tiles (tile sizes: 2064, 4097)
- instrument memcpy path with a toggle to validate last-byte masks on quantized layouts
- follow-up perf run with align=64 to compare throughput drop

kevin: sounds good. tag me once you have the ticket. i'll review the test and help debug the memcpy path. :thumbsup:

maria: created RED-4287: "tiled prefill kv corruption on quantized pack boundaries" with links to artifacts and test command. assigning to @maria, reviewers: @kevin, @ana.

devon: thanks — can add a quick fuzz harness to kv_cache_test to try random tile sizes. might catch other edge cases.

maria: agreed. i'll add fuzz and the align=64 perf comparison as follow-ups. will update thread with PR.
